info.title: PumpGTM API
info.description: Run outreach from your own backend or agent: plain REST for sequences, leads, people search, replies and webhooks; X follower eligibility and review-first X Plays; and the Partner API for agencies and platforms that run PumpGTM for many end users from one account (hosted LinkedIn connect links, per-user workspaces, X-Eve-User). The workspace MCP key also authenticates REST. Start at https://pumpgtm.com/docs/api. No browser session required.

post.summary: Check whether leads follow your account
post.description: Direction: the lead follows the connected account. Supply exactly one X identity per lead. Handles use direct relationship evidence. Numeric IDs use a bounded public follower snapshot: presence is true; absence is null, never a verified false. null means unknown, not eligible or ineligible. Provider errors can produce HTTP 200 with unknown individual results. Up to 100 leads; sequential work is time bounded, so small batches are preferable. Per-instance short cache may be reused; checkedAt is evidence time. No messages are sent.

Existing leads (including stopped/replied leads) keep their original state and sequence. Repeating a completed good-fit review returns already_reviewed; conflicting review decisions return 409. POST /plays/{id}/leads is an alias.

patch.description: Two groups, each behind its own capability (GET /account enterprise). post.summary: Mint a hosted LinkedIn connect link
post.description: 409 account_limit_reached when every LinkedIn account included in your plan is already connected (see accounts on GET /account). Enterprise. Returns a PumpGTM-hosted url (shown once, never stored in clear) where this end user signs in to LinkedIn themselves; open it in a popup, never an iframe. Links are single use and expire after 7 days by default (expiresInMinutes 10 to 43200). Completion is announced through your linkedin.connected webhook and the redirect URLs from PATCH /account; GET the link to poll. Webhook, redirect and poll have no ordering guarantee: treat all three as idempotent on connectLink.id. This route creates the user's workspace if it does not exist yet. A user may hold at most 10 open links (409 connect_link_limit_reached). 400 invalid_expires_in_minutes with field. A 409 saying the link cannot be minted because of a problem with your partner account creates nothing; contact PumpGTM rather than retrying.
